title: Ssaddaaka Ekkirizibwa mu Kusaasira
intro: Ggala amaaso go era okobe ekifaananyi ky’ekiwonvu ekinene era ekisirifu okukkiriza mwe kugezesebwa okutuuka ku kkomo lyakwo. Ogenda okusisinkana ffiga eyagondera mu bukkakkamu mu maaso g’ekiragiro ekitayinza kulowoozebwako kyafuula akaseera ak’okugezesebwa akabonero akataggwaawo ak’obuwulize n’okusaasira okw’obwakatonda.
clues: Njjukirwa mu Quran mu abo abaagumiikiriza n’obugumiikiriza obunywevu.
Nali wakati mu kwolesebwa okwagezesa okugondera ekiragiro kya Allah.
Bwe nnabuulirwa okwolesebwa, nagamba nti mukole nga bwe balagiddwa era mujja kunsanga mu mulwadde.
Nagalamizibwa ku ssaddaaka, naye Allah n’akoowoola nti okwolesebwa kutuukiridde.
Allah yannunula ne ssaddaaka ennene, n’andekera ekitiibwa mu milembe egyaddirira.
Nze Ismail, eyasitula ne Ibrahim emisingi gy’Ennyumba Entukuvu, eyogerwako ku mabbali ga Idris ne Dhul-Kifl mu batuukirivu.
